conditional_induction.analytic_solution: sparse Picard series with a finite C_n on a smaller eta neighborhood
conditional_induction.current_moment_map: B*c=-z_n, with all lower-order products held fixed

conditional_summation.normalized_background_velocity_error: O(q^(2h)) on each fixed enlarged compact annulus
conditional_summation.scale_condition: a_(n+1)>=2*a_n, with each finite list of seminorms through order n
conditional_summation.stress_error: O(q^(2h)*zeta*delta^(-N_I)); only order one needs an edge inverse power

protocol.scope: Conditional all-order background, common support, divergence-preserving asymptotic sum and flat augmented error. The retained stress is not a full physical wave covariance; the bare residual, full field, smooth forcing, energy and blow-up remain open.
